Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Early Rush production game sprite, ONE character, ONE frame, down-facing idle.
Create a clean charming rounded simplified 2.5D sprite of a young adult commuter protagonist. Camera locked at very high 75-degree overhead elevation looking down toward the north; NOT isometric, no diagonal camera, north-up XY world. Character faces south / image bottom: top of dark brown short tidy hair most visible, a little forehead/face under it, shoulders and feet clearly readable. Small adult proportions with slightly enlarged head. Coral orange lightweight jacket, cream shirt, muted deep teal trousers, cream sneakers. No bag or held object. Matte illustrated toy-like forms, restrained soft painted volume, clean readable silhouette, no heavy outlines, crisp production edges. Lighting fixed from image upper-left, only self shading, NO cast ground shadow (separate asset). Real transparent alpha background, not checkerboard.
Canvas aspect 2:3, ideally exactly 256x384 pixels. Keep maximum silhouette horizontal span 76% of canvas; keep the midpoint BETWEEN the two feet's ground contact positions at x=50%, y=90% measured from TOP. Full character visible with clear transparent safety margins. Neutral symmetric planted idle, feet about shoulder width, arms relaxed. Keep consistent camera scale, body proportions and ground contact for subsequent four directions. No scene, no floor, no text, no logo, no grid, no border. This is the first style anchor for a cream / teal / yellow morning commuter game.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate the final Early Rush down-facing idle game sprite using the supplied character as the identity and material reference. Keep exactly the same young adult commuter, dark brown hair, coral jacket, cream shirt, teal pants, ivory sneakers. CHANGE camera to near-top-down 75 degree elevation (15 degrees from vertical): much more top of head and shoulders visible, face mostly hidden by head, torso and legs strongly foreshortened. Current reference is too front-facing and tall. Compact overhead silhouette rather than a portrait. Camera fixed north-up, character faces image bottom, parallel projection. Single isolated full body, no cast ground shadow, no glow or halo, actual transparent alpha. Canvas 1024x1536, character compact 780px wide and roughly 850px tall, feet midpoint at (512,1382), large clear area above head is intentional and must be preserved. Smooth matte rounded toy illustration matching reference. No grid no labels no other items.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE game ground material tile for Early Rush, exactly square 512x512 preferred, full bleed fully opaque. Straight perpendicular top-down flat texture, desaturated light blue gray asphalt with very subtle tiny aggregate speckles, soft matte illustrated finish suitable for a cream ivory / teal / yellow cheerful commuter game. Low contrast so coral player and teal props remain highly legible. Perfectly seamless repeating across both horizontal and vertical borders, uniform illumination and uniform detail distribution, no vignette, no perspective, no shadows, no objects, no road paint, no lines, no sidewalk, no text, no large distinctive stones or stains, no frame. It will be cut into 4x4 adjacent subtiles; the entire image must be one continuous material with NO visible grid.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Early Rush single pushable bicycle wheel game sprite, isolated on actual transparent alpha. Clean rounded toy-like 2.5D illustration, fixed north-up orthographic camera at 75 degrees overhead elevation. ONE intact slim black charcoal rubber bicycle tire with pale metal rim and six clearly separated cream metal spokes, a teal central hub. Upright freestanding wheel leaning only slightly, as a narrow elliptical silhouette viewed steeply from above; not a car tire, not a lying flat ring, not a full bike, no axle stand. Entire wheel visible. Upper-left fixed soft light, matte material, crisp silhouette, no cast ground shadow. Square 256x256 preferred; object horizontal span 72-80% of image, ground contact at (50%,90% from top), transparent safe margins. Palette charcoal teal ivory, no orange. No scene, no floor, no text, no glow, no checkerboard.
